routes.name: R_SMOOTH_FROBENIUS
routes.reason: Smooth-source genus invariance requires smoothness and H^0 equal to the ground field; the allowed inseparable constant covers satisfy neither.

C9000202.statement: Independently certify a substantive exact verification or refutation of a load-bearing assertion in manuscript family 202.

C_GENUS.statement: Under the exact hypotheses of thm:inseparable-genus, nu_F(Z)/d >= sum_i(1-1/r_i), retaining all inseparable constant and residue degrees.

C_TWIST_INDEX.statement: The translated cyclic twist has index p^s, and after [F:F0]_p <= p^h every divisor degree on E_F or a regular finite cover is divisible by p^(s-h).

C_LABEL_RANK.statement: For every subset I, the covectors (1,-t_i^*eta) over FF' have rank at least |I|-h.

C_ABSOLUTE_GENUS.statement: For a regular integral projective curve C over S finitely generated over perfect kappa, Omega_(C/kappa) is locally free of rank trdeg(S/kappa)+1 and deg_S det Omega_(C/kappa) = -2 chi_S(C).

C_HEIGHT_ONE.statement: An exponent-one finite map of such curves, of degree q=p^a, has locally free absolute tangent kernel F and cokernel Q of rank a, det Q=(det F)^p, and nu(C)=q nu(C')+(p-1)deg F.

C_FULL_DIVISOR.statement: At each label with nontrivial purely inseparable ramification, the constant conormal covector annihilates the tangent-map image modulo the full pullback divisor; exterior powers give the image-degree bound.

C_TOWER.statement: The Frobenius tower M_j=M_e M_z^(p^j) gives the 1/p genus recurrence and the weighted contribution at least sum_i(1-1/r_i), with error at most h+log_p d.

C_DESCENT_ROUNDING.statement: Both nu_F(Z) and d sum_i(1-1/r_i) are degrees of divisors over F; their difference is a multiple of p^(s-h) strictly larger than its negative.

C_RANK_PROFILE.statement: For a purely inseparable cover of a genus-one curve split as a constant elliptic curve over a finite separable extension of a finitely generated field over perfect characteristic-p constants, nu_F(Z)/d is at least the weighted sum of max(0,c_j-m_j), with c_j the rank of the ramified-label absolute conormal covectors. For an integer h>=0 bounding every subset's rank loss, the full marked-ramification bound follows under the exact degree-lattice threshold N>d sum_j (1-1/p)p^(-j)(h+m_j).

C_OPTIMAL_PROFILE.statement: For prime p, integer h>=0 and positive height-one stage ranks summing to a>=1, the weighted error is at most U_p(a,h)=max_(1<=b<=a) ((h+1)(1-p^(-b))+(1-1/p)(a-b)). The maximum is attained at b=min(a,min{b>=1:p^b>=h+1}); with U_p(0,h)=0, N>p^A U_p(A,h), A=floor(log_p m), suffices uniformly for d<=m.

C_FORMAL_CORE.statement: The finite-matrix Frobenius determinant identity has exponent +p; the rational height-one recurrence numerator, finite geometric sum, universal positive-list discounted-error bound, and strict integer degree-lattice deduction hold exactly as encoded in GenusAudit's Lean declarations. This claim does not formalize the geometric theorem.

C_THRESHOLD_STRICTNESS.statement: The strict threshold N>dE in the generalized rank-profile theorem cannot uniformly be weakened to N>=dE: in characteristic two, the index-two translated torsor with constant orbit divisor O+P and its descended Frobenius endomorphism has h=1, d=2, N=dE=2, both local indices two, and nu=0. This is outside the manuscript's generic-label and strict-threshold hypotheses.

C_WEIGHT.statement: For every finite group G, prime p and p-block B, l(B)=|W_p(B)| (intro.tex, thm:main).

C_GROUP_REDUCTION.statement: Uniform tuple divisibility for all J with O_p(J)=1 implies the blockwise chain identity and hence the blockwise Alperin weight equality (group.tex, prop:group-reduction).

C_GROUP_TRACE_CHAIN.statement: The tuple trace, p-core cancellation, alternating subsections, trace limit, chain transform and normalizer projection yield the group reduction.

C_TUPLE_DIVISIBILITY.statement: For O_p(J)=1 and every h, p^h divides the generating-tuple count for n=p^s sufficiently large, uniformly in the multiset of p-singular classes.

C_NO_SMALL_COVER.statement: Under the genus threshold and O_p(J)=1, no extension of p-part degree below p^h supports the required J-cover (prop:no-small-cover).

C_SPECIALIZATION_MODEL.statement: Sharp Euler-characteristic and residue-degree comparisons produce the claimed flat projective model (prop:specialization-model).

C_SEPARABLE_DIFFERENT.statement: The absolute determinant gives the separable different bound including e-1+1_(p divides e), with inseparable residue degrees retained.

C_VALUATION_COMPARISONS.statement: The valued-field construction and section comparisons give the residue-degree and sharp-specialization interfaces needed by the model.

C_CONNECTEDNESS.statement: A flat projective finite-presentation model with geometrically integral generic fiber has geometrically connected special fiber (lem:valuation-model-connectedness).

C_SMALL_ORBIT.statement: A Sylow-p orbit of size below p^h gives the corresponding cover over a field extension of p-part degree below p^h.

C_MARKED_CLASSIFICATION.statement: Marked J-covers correspond to simultaneous-conjugacy classes of generating tuples [x,y]u_1...u_n=1 with the specified inertia classes.
